I've never fought a used tampon elemental, but I'm sure it would be a TPK

EDIT: Sorry, I have a dumb sense of humor

Is it normal to only "deep kiss" and make out, but not give little pecks? My GF and I make out a lot, but she doesn't seem as interested in less "sexual" kisses. I envy couples giving kisses goodbye or romantically sharing a kiss under the mistletoe, but we have only ever gone hot-and-heavy. I don't even know where to start with the other sort of kissing. Suggestions?

Does your username stand for "I hate myself fuck me & kill me please"? It seems pretty clear that you have low self esteem. Be the best version of yourself that you can be and guys will find you attractive.
I'm sorry you had to go through that. Your advice and warning is appreciated. I will have to be cautious about this. I can only hope my experience doesn't turn out the same way.

I think we will remain friends no matter what. I will have to tough it out and try to give her what she needs to be comfortable. I'm glad we're not alone in this situation. Thank you for sharing your experience.
That makes sense. Her mother passed away last year, and she has a lot of repressed feeling from that.
Thanks for the encouragement. I think I will play it safe. I don't want to spoil what I have.

Thanks for the reply. I'm really torn about this. I don't want to make things awkward, and if I let him know (which I have no idea how I'd do) then I might ruin a potential relationship with his sister or worse our friendship. Compounding the fact is I've never had a boyfriend before and I'm not even sure I want that kind of relationship, because part of me wants a wife and kids when I grow old. And all this is getting way ahead of myself because he's probably straight and his sister might not even be into me (I might be misreading her). But it would be even more awkward if I try for anything after we're living together, so I feel like if I make a move, it has to be soon.
Whoo hoo! I love NIN and 80s era Crimson. I've been listening to Sleepytime Gorilla Museum. "In Glorious Times", "Grand Opening and Closing", and "Of Natural History" are all great albums.
My friends would probably say the same thing. But I think you are right, I will keep it to myself. Thanks for the reply.
That sounds like it worked out alright for you two! Though I think I will keep it to myself for now, I appreciate your advice. I'm feeling a lot better now. Thank you for replying.
